verdicts.reason: A is unusable: 'Cascadia' sits about 500px away from its 'RESTAURANT' line, the headline is jammed against a strip of thumbnail-sized food photos and the plate sketch, the URL drifts on the far left, and the decorative flourishes and pattern tile are scattered without purpose. B at least has a reading order: a red headline on the left and the brand block (Cascadia, RESTAURANT, URL) grouped on the right. But the hero food photos shrink to postage-stamp size inside oversized peach and pattern panels, there is an empty frame box in the middle, and the decorative swashes are as heavy as the content.
